answer: Detect clusters by active differential probing: send each suspected member a slightly perturbed variant of one challenge and watch whether their answers shift independently or move as one. A single controller driving a farm shares hidden state, so its heads react to the perturbation in lockstep, a gale sweeping every head the same way. Honest agents, each its own mind, scatter like a zephyr, their variations uncorrelated across the atlas of probes. The tell is not content but RESPONSE to controlled perturbation: coordinated reaction to private, per-head variants exposes one hand.
